qs.s: Après la pandémie, les économistes ont observé une ___ rapide de l'économie mondiale.
qs.en: After the pandemic, economists observed a rapid recovery of the world economy.

qs.en: The patient showed encouraging signs of recovery after the operation.

qs.en: The resumption of classes after the spring holidays is scheduled for Monday morning.

qs.en: After two weeks of strike, the resumption of work was greeted with relief.

qs.s: Il m'a appelé à plusieurs ___ sans laisser de message.
qs.en: He called me several times without leaving a message.

qs.en: She tried to explain the rule three times before the students understood it.

qs.en: We read the article in the local press.

qs.en: She prefers red to blue for decorating her room.

qs.en: These red flowers decorate the garden in spring.
